FlowerPainter.Feature.pitch.Tooltip: A real-size soccer, American football or rugby pitch (full, 9-, 7- or 5-a-side) on a levelled pad, with painted lines, goals, ball-stop fences, team benches, stands and floodlights. Made smaller to fit when needed.
FlowerPainter.Feature.baseballDiamond.To: A baseball or softball field with home plate in a corner: skinned infield, mound, foul lines, backstop, outfield fence, dugouts, bleachers and floodlights.
FlowerPainter.Feature.runningTrack.Toolt: A 400 m (or 300 m / 200 m) athletics oval with lanes, a turf infield holding a football pitch or field events, stands and floodlights.
FlowerPainter.Feature.tennisCourts.Toolt: One to four fenced tennis courts side by side with full markings, nets, benches and optional floodlights.
FlowerPainter.Feature.basketballCourt.To: A full 28 × 15 m basketball court with three-point lines, two hoops, bleachers, benches and floodlights.
FlowerPainter.Feature.cricketGround.Tool: An oval cricket ground with a 22-yard pitch on a rolled strip, creases, boundary rope, sight screens and a pavilion.
FlowerPainter.Feature.skateBowl.Tooltip: A concrete skate pad with a bowl dug into it (round or kidney-shaped) or a street plaza of ramps and rails.
FlowerPainter.Park.pitchAt.Tooltip: Where the pitch goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When the full size does not fit between the paths, a smaller pitch is used.
FlowerPainter.Park.pitchPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the pitch.
FlowerPainter.Park.baseballDiamondAt.Too: Where the diamond goes. In a corner, home plate tucks into the corner and the foul lines follow the edges. A smaller field is used when the full size does not fit.
FlowerPainter.Park.baseballDiamondPath.T: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the backstop side of the diamond.
FlowerPainter.Park.runningTrackAt.Toolti: Where the track goes. A 400 m oval needs about 1.8 ha of open ground; a 300 m or 200 m track is used when it does not fit.
FlowerPainter.Park.runningTrackPath.Tool: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the track.
FlowerPainter.Park.tennisCourtsAt.Toolti: Where the tennis courts go: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner.
FlowerPainter.Park.tennisCourtsPath.Tool: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the courts' gate.
FlowerPainter.Park.basketballCourtAt.Too: Where the full basketball court goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner.
FlowerPainter.Park.basketballCourtPath.T: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the court.
FlowerPainter.Park.cricketGroundAt.Toolt: Where the cricket ground goes. A club ground needs about 1.4 ha of open ground; a village or school ground is used when it does not fit.
FlowerPainter.Park.cricketGroundPath.Too: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the pavilion side of the ground.
FlowerPainter.Park.skateBowlAt.Tooltip: Where the skate bowl goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner.
FlowerPainter.Park.skateBowlPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the skate bowl.
FlowerPainter.Field.Issue.Smaller: The {0} was built at a smaller size so that it fits.
FlowerPainter.Field.Issue.Orientation: The field could not be turned to the chosen direction here; it follows the space instead.
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.Issue.Fewer: Only {0} of {1} tennis courts fit here.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.Name: Football pitch
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.code.Tooltip: Soccer (penalty areas, centre circle), American football (yard lines, hash marks, end zones) or rugby (22 m, 10 m and 5 m lines, in-goal areas).
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.format.Tooltip: Full size is 105 × 68 m. Smaller formats are the youth pitches: 73 × 46 m (9-a-side), 55 × 37 m (7-a-side), 37 × 27 m (5-a-side). Auto picks the biggest that fits.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.turf.Tooltip: A mown grass surface over the pitch and its run-off, so it reads as a pitch rather than park lawn.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.lines.Tooltip: Pitch markings painted as marking decals (only when marking decals are installed).
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.lineSpacing.To: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.stands.Tooltip: Bleachers along the touchline people arrive from, or along both touchlines.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.teamBenches.To: Benches either side of halfway on the far touchline.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.floodlights.To: Floodlight masts at the four corners, or at the corners and halfway.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.ballStops.Tool: Fences behind both goals so the ball does not roll into the park.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.rail.Tooltip: A low fence round the pitch with a gap towards the path.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.level.Tooltip: Levels the pitch and blends the ground back to the original height at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.at.Tooltip: Where the pitch goes when it finds its own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.orientation.To: Auto follows the space; north–south keeps the low sun out of the players' eyes.
FlowerPainter.Field.Pitch.pathTo.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the pitch when it finds its own spot.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.Name: Baseball diamond
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.format.Tool: Major (99 m fences, 90 ft bases), community (80 m), softball (67 m, 60 ft bases), Little League (61 m) or tee-ball (46 m). Auto picks the biggest that fits.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.infieldDirt: Dirt infield cut round the grass diamond, with the mound and the home-plate circle (all dirt for softball and tee-ball).
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.warningTrac: A dirt band just inside the outfield fence (larger fields).
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.lines.Toolt: Foul lines, batter's boxes, on-deck circles, bases and plate as marking decals (when installed).
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.lineSpacing: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.backstop.To: A curved fence behind home plate.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.fence.Toolt: Fences along both foul lines and the outfield arc; the gaps by the dugouts are the gates.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.dugouts.Too: A shelter (or team benches) beside each foul line between home and first / third base.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.stands.Tool: Bleachers along both foul lines past the dugouts.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.floodlights: Light towers outside the foul lines, and two beyond the outfield fence with six.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.level.Toolt: Levels the field and blends the ground back to the original height at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.at.Tooltip: Where the diamond goes when it finds its own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.orientation: Auto follows the space; north–south or east–west squares the field to the compass.
FlowerPainter.Field.Baseball.pathTo.Tool: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the field when it finds its own spot.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.Name: Running track
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.format.Tooltip: A 400 m oval with 8 or 6 lanes, a 300 m school track or a 200 m mini track. Auto picks the biggest that fits.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.infield.Toolti: A football pitch inside the oval (plus long jump and shot put on 400 m and 300 m tracks), field events only, or plain lawn.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.turf.Tooltip: A mown grass surface inside the kerb.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.lines.Tooltip: Kerb, lanes, finish line and the infield markings as marking decals (when installed).
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.lineSpacing.To: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.laneLines.Tool: Lane lines along the home straight only, or all the way round.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.stands.Tooltip: Stands along the home straight (the side people arrive from), or along both straights.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.floodlights.To: Masts at the four ends of the straights, plus one behind each bend with six.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.fence.Tooltip: A fence round the whole track with a gate towards the path.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.level.Tooltip: Levels the track and blends the ground back to the original height at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.at.Tooltip: Where the track goes when it finds its own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.orientation.To: Auto follows the space; north–south keeps the low sun out of the runners' eyes on the straights.
FlowerPainter.Field.Track.pathTo.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the track when it finds its own spot.
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.Name: Tennis courts
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.courts.Toolti: How many courts side by side in one fenced block (fewer are built when they do not fit).
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.lines.Tooltip: Baselines, sidelines, service lines and centre marks as marking decals (when installed).
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.lineSpacing.T: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.fence.Tooltip: A fence round the block of courts with one gate towards the path.
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.level.Tooltip: Levels the courts and blends the ground back at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.at.Tooltip: Where the courts go when they find their own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.orientation.T: Auto follows the space; north–south keeps the low sun out of the players' eyes.
FlowerPainter.Field.Tennis.pathTo.Toolti: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the courts when they find their own spot.
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.Name: Full basketball court
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.format.To: A full FIBA court (28 × 15 m) or a compact 26 × 14 m school court. Auto picks the biggest that fits.
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.paintedKe: A paved surface over each restricted area so the keys stand out (a second surface on top of the court).
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.lines.Too: Boundary, halfway, circles, keys and three-point lines as marking decals (when installed).
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.lineSpaci: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.fence.Too: A fence round the court with one gate towards the path.
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.stands.To: Bleachers along the sideline people arrive from.
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.level.Too: Levels the court and blends the ground back at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.at.Toolti: Where the court goes when it finds its own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.orientati: Auto follows the space; north–south keeps the low sun out of the players' eyes.
FlowerPainter.Field.Basketball.pathTo.To: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the court when it finds its own spot.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.Name: Cricket ground
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.format.Toolt: Boundary size: county (about 70 m), club (55 m), village (45 m) or school (35 m). Auto picks the biggest that fits.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.boundary.Too: A painted boundary rope, a low fence with a gate towards the path, or nothing.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.square.Toolt: A mown grass square round the rolled pitch strip.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.lines.Toolti: Creases, stumps and the boundary rope as marking decals (when installed).
Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.fieldingCirc: Disc markers along the 30-yard circle (when the ground is big enough).
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.sightScreens: Screens behind both ends in line with the pitch.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.pavilion.Too: A pavilion on the boundary people arrive from, with small stands either side.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.level.Toolti: Levels the outfield and blends the ground back at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.at.Tooltip: Where the ground goes when it finds its own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
Auto follows the space; north–south keeps the low sun out of the batters' eyes.
FlowerPainter.Field.Cricket.pathTo.Toolt: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the ground when it finds its own spot.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.Name: Skate bowl
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.style.Tooltip: A round bowl, a kidney-shaped pool, or a street plaza of ramps and rails without a bowl.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.format.Tooltip: Pad size: large (34 × 26 m) or small (26 × 20 m). Auto picks the biggest that fits.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.depth.Tooltip: How deep the bowl is dug into the pad (permanent terrain change). Not used by the street plaza.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.obstacles.Tool: Ramps, rails and boxes on the flat deck, facing the bowl.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.lines.Tooltip: Marks the bowl's rim with marking decals (when installed).
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.lineSpacing.To: Distance between the decals along the rim.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.fence.Tooltip: A fence round the pad with one gate towards the path.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.level.Tooltip: Levels the pad and blends the ground back at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.at.Tooltip: Where the pad goes when it finds its own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.orientation.To: Auto follows the space, or square the pad to the compass.
FlowerPainter.Field.Skate.pathTo.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the pad when it finds its own spot.
